title: Hinomori Shizuku — Cooking To Give You Energy♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, this soap dispenser's running low.
I should refill it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's been so long since the last time I was on duty for the health committee...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The others are always covering for me. I really need to do my best today.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That should do it.
Okay, my next stop is...
Huh? Shizuku?
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka!
It's rare to see you here this late.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was borrowing a book from the library.
What were you doing just now, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was taking care of some health committee business.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm patrolling to look for any soap dispensers that need refilling.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I need to do my best, for everyone's health!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've been receiving more offers to appear on TV recently, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If we happen to be asked to become regulars for a show or do a long shoot, then I'll likely be spending even less time with the health committee.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why my plan is to do what I can whenever I do have time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. I'd expect no less from you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I kind of envy you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I haven't been a part of many committees, so I've kind of always wanted to stay after school, doing those sorts of things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, in that case... Would you like to join me, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes. What do you say?
Your help would be much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks...
Then, just for today, I'll be the newest member of the health committee.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to your thorough instruction, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course, Haruka!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, here's another dispenser.
Would you mind helping me with it, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As we discussed, I'll hold it while you refill it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, try not to get any soap on your hands. I wouldn't want it to slip out of your hands and fall to the floor.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
It would be dangerous if the floor got slippery.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. One time, I almost slipped and fell while refilling the dispensers after I spilled some soap.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I don't want you or anyone else who walks by here to suffer the same fate!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Th-That happened?
I'm glad you didn't actually fall.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, I'll be very careful not to get any of the soap onto my hands...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Excellent job!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But you're also a very good teacher.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I appreciate you saying that.
Anyway, our next stop is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, do you need help finding it?
If you tell me about where, then I can...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
Please, follow me.
se_walk_women_002_3
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Go down the stairs, take a right, turn again at the end and...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You found it!
Without getting lost!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I still get lost from time to time when I have to change classrooms by myself...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I've made it a point to memorize where all the soap dispensers are while working for the health committee.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. You really are doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind leading the way today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Phew... That's the last one.
Thank you for all your hard work, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your help made everything go so smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm glad I could help.
And thank you for letting me join you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for your assistance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, Shizuku, you did a great job of leading today. You taught me everything I needed to know, and got things done so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The school should be safe with you on the health committee.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I promise to keep doing my best, for everyone's health!
